Name: (CP) Daulton and Maple - Nyapu's Style
Author: charri67
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Content Patcher conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PureJJoy]PureJJoy[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38691?tab=description]Nyapu-style Daulton and Maple [/url]mod. Reuploaded with Joy's permission.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]I recommend using a mod manager to install, such as Vortex or, my personal favorite, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop[/url]. In a mod manager, just drag and drop the zip and enable it! [/size][/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]If installing manually, extract the files from the zip into a folder, then move the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. [/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]Requires the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35087]Daulton and Maple [/url]mod; PureJJoy's mod has been repackaged so the original isn't required, but please endorse them anyway for their hard work creating the art assets. You need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher [/url]to use this.[/size]
